content: Lei 13.709/2018 Art. 18 grants access, correction, anonymization/block/deletion of unnecessary data, and deletion of consent-based data except Art. 16. ANPD treats IP as an electronic-communication identifier. ANPD Res. CD/ANPD 2 (2022) Art. 6-7: small-agent flex does not waive titular rights; Art. 14 only doubles response time. Hiding IP in UI while storing/returning it is still tratamento.
